title: 100ml Vape Juice & 2000mg CBD
description:
Choose a best-selling e-liquid from Fantasi, Ferocious, or Juicy Blast
High Strength 2000mg CBD
A delicious way to add CBD to your daily routine!
Money-saving bundle deal!
70/30 Shortfill Vape Juice & 2000mg CBD E-Liquid:
Combine your favorite flavored e-liquid with CBD! Simply pick your favorite flavor of Ferocious, Fantasia or Juicy Blast E-Liquid and receive two additional CBD Isolate 1000mg Shots to be added to your bottle!
Choose from some of your favourite flavours with this combination pack!
Each flavoured bottle is supplied in a 120ml bottle with 20ml of space left over for you to add the CBD isolate 1000mg shots (included).
Mix them both together by shaking the bottle, and you’re good to go!
It’s now easier than ever to get your daily dose of CBD!
Natural and flavourless CBD e-liquid that can be used in all devices
Full true strength without any additional flavourings
Premium grade cannabidiol (CBD) isolate 1000mg strength
70% Propylene Glycol
30% Vegetable Glycerin
Supplied in 10ml child-proof bottles
Certified THC Free
The CBD isolate used in our products is 3rd party lab tested for potency and for purity/contaminants. Fully MHRA (Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency) compliant and manufactured under strict Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) protocols in a state-of-the-art IS0 7 clean room.
This product is a food supplement and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Recommended usage:
Vape as you normally would but hold the vapour in your lungs for slightly longer (up to 15 seconds) to help CBD uptake. If you haven’t used CBD before, it may be helpful to start off with small quantities and see how you feel. The effects of CBD can sometimes be quite immediate but for some people, it can take longer.
We would recommend using our CBD e-liquid with a
plus-ohm coil/device
(above 1.0Ω) at a low wattage (around 10-20w). That’s because the higher proportion of PG means the liquid is thinner than average. With that said, you can use this liquid with a sub-ohm device, but keep in mind it’ll give you a much stronger throat hit and your coils won’t last as long.
Storage:
Store upright in a cool, dark place away from the reach of children and pets.
Warning:
Not to be used or sold to anyone under the age of 18
